text:
mina: planning to work from Porto, Portugal for 30 days: 2026-10-05 -> 2026-11-04. quick ones: 1) is the monthly WFH stipend pro-rated? 2) should i expect any Portuguese withholding or benefits issues? 3) do i change homebase? 4) can IT forward a charger & local plug adapter?
maria (people-ops): short answers: 1) yes, stipend pro-rated by days in the month; payroll calculates. 2) short international stays can trigger personal withholding or reporting; company-level nexus unlikely for a single 30-day trip but payroll/legal should confirm. 3) do NOT change homebase for <6 months; use Temp Remote form and select international. 4) IT can ship a charger/adapter with waiver.
mina: link to form? and any visa concerns? i'm traveling on a tourist visa.
thiago (payroll): we'll open a ticket once the Temp Remote form is submitted. payroll will estimate stipend proration and flag if any withholding or reporting needed for Portugal. ETA 48-72 hours.
samir (legal): tourist visas are typically fine for remote work but confirm local rules; Portugal has a D7 and digital nomad guidance but for 30 days you should be OK. If you plan client-facing meetings or deliverables in-country, let us know.
oliver (it): we can ship charger+adapter. For international shipments: signed equipment waiver required and we recommend shipping to a secure address. ETA 7-10 biz days after sign-off.
mina: address i'll put on the form:


benefits-bot: benefits note: US medical doesn't cover routine care abroad. Telehealth and EAP ok. Consider short-term travel insurance for >30 days.
maria (people-ops): thanks all. mina, submit the Temp Remote form and attach waiver. payroll (thiago) will post estimates here.
thiago (payroll): PR-5522 created. Early estimate: Oct stipend proration = $100.00, Nov partial (if any) pro-rate handled on return. No immediate withholding flagged but final confirm once we process.
mina: form submitted and waiver signed. thanks everyone! :portugal:
